product.name: Scentbird Fragrance Subscription
product.description: A recurring service that lets members select from more than 1,100 designer perfumes and colognes and receive an 8 mL travel vial each month.

product.name: Perfume and Cologne Marketplace
product.description: An online catalog for purchasing perfume and cologne samples, travel sprays, full-size fragrances, and products from designer and independent fragrance brands.

product.name: Beauty Subscription
product.description: A sampling service for skincare and other beauty products, allowing customers to discover formulas from selected beauty brands through recurring deliveries.

product.name: Scent Profile and Fragrance Quiz
product.description: A digital recommendation tool that uses a customer’s fragrance preferences to identify scent families and suggest suitable perfumes or colognes.

product.name: Fragrance Cases and Travel Accessories
product.description: Protective cases and related accessories designed to hold and transport Scentbird fragrance vials for everyday or travel use.
